articles.title: Kelce equals Holmes as Chiefs' career TD leader
articles.summary: Travis Kelce led the Chiefs to a comfortable win over the Commanders with six receptions on eight targets for 99 yards -- and his 83rd career touchdown, which tied former running back Priest Holmes for the most total touchdowns in franchise history.

articles.title: Ravens expect Lamar to start Thursday at Miami
articles.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson is expected to return from a hamstring injury and start Thursday night's game at Miami, coach John Harbaugh said Monday.

articles.title: Vikings' Wentz to have season-ending surgery
articles.summary: Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz will undergo season-ending surgery on his left shoulder.

articles.title: Sources: Broncos CB Surtain expected out weeks
articles.summary: Broncos cornerback Pat Surtain II is expected to miss multiple games with a left pectoral strain and could be a candidate for injured reserve, sources told ESPN on Monday.

articles.title: Sources: Steelers plan to sign Valdes-Scantling
articles.summary: The Steelers, who lost to the Green Bay Packers in Pittsburgh on Sunday, plan to sign wide receiver Marquez Valdes-Scantling, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Monday, a move that will reunite the 31-year-old veteran with quarterback Aaron Rodgers.

articles.title: Rams acquire CB McCreary in trade with Titans
articles.summary: The Titans traded cornerback Roger McCreary to the Rams for a conditional draft pick swap on Monday.

articles.title: 'All went well': Skattebo undergoes ankle surgery
articles.summary: Giants rookie running back Cam Skattebo had surgery Sunday night on the dislocated ankle he suffered in Sunday's loss to the Eagles, and "all went well," coach Brian Daboll said during a videoconference call on Monday afternoon.

articles.title: Bengals defense meets after 'unacceptable' play
articles.summary: A historically poor showing on Cincinnati's home field produced a players-only meeting for the Bengals' defense Monday, the day after a 39-38 loss to the New York Jets, a last-place club that was winless entering the weekend.
